components.description: SQLite append-only forecast/outcome/event ledger; deterministic IDs; fixed horizons; UTC and look-ahead checks; immutable row guards; Brier/log-loss and baseline scoring; cohort-separated summaries.
Covers idempotency, horizons, timestamps, leakage, probability validity, outcome tolerance, cross-venue normalization, unscorable outcomes, immutability, calibration bins and cohort separation.
Explicitly includes the new forecast-ledger test module.
Excludes SQLite runtime DB and WAL/SHM/journal sidecars.

limits: Ledger records and scores; it does not generate forecasts, ingest data, train or trade.
SQLite triggers are not cryptographic tamper protection.
Feature-store contract is design only; no adapter or historical database is implemented.
Missing outcome data is unscorable, not a miss.
Metrics are cohort-separated; unlike horizons and venues are not pooled.
verification_required: CI must collect and pass all 22 tests in tests/test_forecast_ledger.py.
Fail-closed gate must pass and automatic merging remain disabled.
Exact-head readback must confirm runtime DB ignore rules and CI test inclusion.
next_actions: Build public-data adapters with source provenance and revision timestamps.
Populate historical XRP snapshots without backdating source availability.
Run chronological walk-forward tests against simple baselines.
Add class-wise calibration, uncertainty and drift before shadow/paper evaluation.
